steps.why_en: The endorse form exists but is hidden from the menu and not limited to a 2OIC.
steps.why_id: Form endorse ada tetapi disembunyikan dari menu dan tidak dibatasi untuk 2OIC.

steps.en: OCMS updates the decision and the compound amount
steps.id: OCMS meng-update keputusan dan nominal compound
steps.why_en: Nothing in the system saves the decision or amount; the amount is patched by hand.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada bagian sistem yang menyimpan keputusan atau nominal; nominal di-patch manual.

steps.en: The notice moves to the first letter stage after endorsement
steps.id: Notice masuk stage surat pertama setelah endorsement
steps.why_en: The notice is put on the first letter stage when it is created, before any endorsement.
steps.why_id: Notice sudah ditaruh di stage surat pertama saat dibuat, sebelum ada endorsement.

steps.en: OCMS selects notices ready for the first letter
steps.id: OCMS memilih notice yang siap menerima surat pertama
steps.why_en: Selection depends only on stage and date, not on the endorsed decision.
steps.why_id: Pemilihan hanya berdasarkan stage dan tanggal, tidak berdasarkan keputusan yang sudah di-endorse.

steps.en: OCMS creates the letter file with the compound amount
steps.id: OCMS membuat file surat berisi nominal compound
steps.why_en: Letters are made only by a manual trigger, and the amount stays at zero until patched by hand.
steps.why_id: Surat hanya dibuat lewat trigger manual, dan nominal tetap nol sampai di-patch manual.

steps.en: OCMS sends the file to the print vendor
steps.id: OCMS mengirim file ke vendor cetak
steps.why_en: Sending to the vendor is switched off in the settings, yet the notice still moves on.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor dimatikan di pengaturan, tetapi notice tetap maju.
